newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Stockholm bourse turnover up 60 pct so far in '97.
newsitem.headline: Stockholm bourse turnover up 60 pct so far in '97.

text.p: Stockholm Stock Exchange said on Wednesday that turnover on the bourse had surged 60 percent so far this year, compared to the corresponding period a year earlier.
"We do not know how long turnover will continue to rise this way," Bengt Ryden, head of the bourse, told the exchange's annual general shareholders' meeting.
Companies were also more interested than ever in becoming listed, with 30 companies waiting to be introduced and hoping it will happen before the summer.
"We who work here have never seen anything like it," Ryden said. "We are under hard pressure, but we must continue to demand high standards for companies becoming listed."
